evals.prompt: Deploy chatqna core with docker compose. I did not provide runtime or device.
evals.expected_output: Defaults to OpenVINO CPU profile and provides a valid deployment command sequence from preflight to health verification.
expectations: Defaults runtime and device to openvino plus cpu when not provided.
Uses source scripts/setup_env.sh for default OpenVINO CPU selection.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d to start services.
Includes health validation at /v1/chatqna/health.
Uses docker/compose.yaml and avoids placeholder compose file tokens such as <compose-file>.

evals.prompt: Deploy OpenVINO GPU profile for chatqna with docker compose.
evals.expected_output: Uses the GPU profile command path and includes fallback behavior when render nodes are unavailable.
expectations: Uses source scripts/setup_env.sh -d gpu for GPU profile selection.
Checks or references /dev/dri/render availability for GPU support.

States the fallback rule to OpenVINO CPU for when GPU render devices are missing — either by performing that fallback if the check finds no render node, or by stating the rule as guidance if the check finds render devices present in this environment.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d as the deployment start command.

evals.prompt: Deploy chatqna with ollama backend using docker compose.
evals.expected_output: Selects Ollama CPU profile and provides the compose startup and verification flow.
expectations: Includes source scripts/setup_env.sh -b ollama in the deployment flow.
States that Ollama path is CPU-only in this skill.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d.
Includes health check for /v1/chatqna/health.

evals.prompt: Deploy chatqna with prebuilt images. What should I export before deploy?
evals.expected_output: Provides pinned default exports using compose variables REGISTRY, BACKEND_TAG, and UI_TAG before startup.
expectations: Includes export REGISTRY="intel/".
Includes export BACKEND_TAG="core_2026.2.0-rc2" (or runtime-specific pinned backend tag).
Includes export UI_TAG="core_2026.2.0-rc2".
Uses pinned defaults when tags are not provided.
Does not replace BACKEND_TAG/UI_TAG with a generic TAG variable or latest default.

evals.prompt: Run preflight checks for docker deployment first.
evals.expected_output: Includes Docker and Docker Compose version checks before running deployment commands.
expectations: Includes docker --version.
Includes docker compose version.
Keeps deployment workflow in Docker Compose context.

evals.prompt: After startup, provide readiness evidence for chatqna docker deployment.
evals.expected_output: Provides evidence commands and expects running services plus HTTP 200 health status.
expectations: Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml ps for readiness evidence collection.
Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml logs --tail=150 or similar for readiness evidence collection.
Includes curl health probe with HTTP status formatting for /v1/chatqna/health.
Requires or references HTTP_STATUS:200 in readiness evidence.

evals.prompt: After the container is up, how to access ChatQ&A UI and API docs?
evals.expected_output: Returns the ChatQ&A UI and API docs URLs using the documented gateway host and port.
expectations: Provides UI URL using http://<HOST_IP>:8102 or http://localhost:8102.
Provides API docs URL ending with /v1/chatqna/docs.

evals.prompt: Stop chatqna deployment and provide proof containers are terminated.
evals.expected_output: Uses docker compose down and includes docker ps evidence of stopped state.
expectations: Includes docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml down.
Includes docker ps as the termination evidence command, with real command output when actually run, or clearly-labeled expected/sample output when execution is out of scope.

Does not run or present the optional deep cleanup down -v --remove-orphans command as one of the required stop steps; it is acceptable to mention it only as a clearly-labeled optional aside that was not executed and is unrelated to this plain stop request.

evals.prompt: setup_env.sh returned an unsupported backend or device value.
evals.expected_output: Follows failure-handling guidance by constraining backend/device to supported values and providing corrected setup_env.sh invocation(s) for a valid profile.
expectations: Restricts backend to openvino or ollama.
Restricts device to cpu or gpu where valid (gpu only with OpenVINO).
Provides at least one corrected setup_env.sh invocation for a supported profile, for example source scripts/setup_env.sh, source scripts/setup_env.sh -d gpu, or source scripts/setup_env.sh -b ollama.
Does not prescribe a hard stop/exit-only path that prevents profile correction and continuation.

evals.prompt: Containers failed to start after docker compose up. Provide troubleshooting workflow.
evals.expected_output: Provides a practical troubleshooting workflow that captures compose status/logs, identifies the failing service, and maps first log errors to actionable fixes before retrying startup.
expectations: Collects docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml logs --tail=200 or similar.
Includes a step to identify the failing service name from compose status or logs.
Includes first-error interpretation guidance from logs (for example image/tag, port, path, permission, GPU, or auth issues).

evals.prompt: Health endpoint is failing right after startup. What needs to be checked?
evals.expected_output: Provides post-start health troubleshooting tied to backend logs, host configuration, and model startup timing.
expectations: Includes checking backend container logs.
Includes validating HOST_IP and selected runtime profile.
Mentions first startup can take longer due to model download or conversion.
Includes re-checking /v1/chatqna/health after stabilization.

evals.prompt: Deploy with a custom model config and Hugging Face token for gated model access.
evals.expected_output: Includes secure environment exports for model config and token without hardcoding secrets.
expectations: Includes export MODEL_CONFIG_PATH with an absolute config path.
Includes export HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN as an environment variable.
Uses a placeholder token value and avoids hardcoding real token values in commands or files.
Includes a valid setup_env.sh profile selection and compose startup flow.
